title: Pocketwire Advance Repayment Settings by Tier
content:
Repayment of a Pocketwire Advance runs on the settings of the line's tier: the length of the repayment term, how autopay collects and retries, and which manual repayments are accepted.

## Term and autopay

| Tier | Repayment term (calendar days from disbursement to due date) | Autopay must stay on | Autopay collects from the next direct deposit first | Autopay retries after a failed collection | Days between retries | Partial autopay collection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 14 | Yes | Yes | 3 | 3 | No |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 21 | Yes | Yes | 3 | 3 | No |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 28 | Yes | Yes | 3 | 3 | Yes |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 28 | Yes | Yes | 3 | 3 | Yes |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 28 | No | Yes | 3 | 2 | Yes |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 28 | No | Yes | 3 | 2 | Yes |

"Autopay collects from the next direct deposit first" means autopay collects from the next direct deposit posting on or after the due date before trying the personal balance of the Pocketwire Personal Account. "Partial autopay collection" means autopay collects a partial amount when the balance is short.

## Manual repayment and allocation

| Tier | Smallest manual repayment (USD) | Manual repayment from an external debit card accepted | Order in which a repayment is applied to one advance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 5.00 | No | Fees, then principal |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 5.00 | Yes | Fees, then principal |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 5.00 | Yes | Fees, then principal |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 5.00 | Yes | Fees, then principal |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 5.00 | Yes | Fees, then principal |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 5.00 | Yes | Fees, then principal |

A repayment of the whole outstanding amount is always allowed, even below the smallest manual repayment.

## Reading the settings

- A hypothetical advance disbursed on a line on Pocketwire Advance Basic falls due 21 calendar days after its disbursement date; on Pocketwire Advance Starter the same advance would fall due after 14 calendar days.
- Pocketwire Advance Max and Pocketwire Advance Elite are the only tiers on which autopay does not have to stay switched on.
- Pocketwire Advance Starter is the only tier on which a manual repayment from an external debit card is not accepted.
